title: Stericycle Waste Pickup
description: Schema for a Stericycle regulated medical waste pickup service record

id.description: Unique identifier for the pickup service record

locationId.description: Identifier for the service location within the account

serviceDate.description: Scheduled date for the waste pickup service

wasteType.description: Category of regulated waste being collected

status.description: Current status of the pickup service

weight.description: Total weight of waste collected in pounds

manifestNumber.description: Regulatory manifest number for waste tracking compliance

treatmentFacility.description: Name of the treatment and disposal facility

complianceDocumentUrl.description: URL to the compliance certificate or manifest document

driverName.description: Name of the Stericycle driver who performed the pickup

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was created
